summary: Iteration 10 — Buried Treasure schedule SYNCED with Work-Scheduler. Backend 9/9 PASS (new GET /api/bt/schedule shape with source/shift, no sleep_all_day/updated_at/is_default; default 08:00-23:00 when scheduler off; scheduler-on day pattern → 06:00-22:00; scheduler-on night pattern → 14:00-06:00 wrap-around; POST /api/bt/schedule returns 405; regression /bt/groups/mine, /bt/groups/available, /bt/settings, /bt/solo/current all 200). critical_code_review_comments: backend/buried_treasure.py::_get_user_schedule correctly lazy-imports _shift_for_date + DEFAULT_SHIFTS from server.py inside the function body to avoid the circular import.

Night-shift wrap-around (start 14:00, sleep 06:00) is exposed as awake_start='14:00', awake_end='06:00' — consumers MUST handle awake_end < awake_start as a wrap. Confirmed is_awake_now logic handles this for the test user's TZ during the run.
POST /api/bt/schedule cleanly returns 405 Method Not Allowed (FastAPI default since GET is still defined on /api/bt/schedule); the legacy bt_player_schedule collection is no longer touched.
Frontend correctly hides bt-open-scheduler when source==='scheduler' and shows it when source==='default'. Pill text reflects is_awake_now ('Active right now' vs 'Inactive — outside awake hours').
